Updated and re-validated `header.json` and `units-001.json` with `plan-lint`:

### 1. Changes in `header.json` and `units-001.json` (`U03`)
- **`header.json`**: Added the explicit convention to always use `const` instead of `let` for variables assigned once (including variables captured by nested closures before the closure is invoked) to satisfy ESLint `prefer-const`.
- **`U03` ([`packages/frontend-app-api/src/wiring/createSpecializedApp.test.tsx`](file:///Users/apple/Documents/GitHub/bs-cells/BS-BF-08/packages/frontend-app-api/src/wiring/createSpecializedApp.test.tsx#L2010-L2019))**: Updated `U03.sites.S1` (lines 2010–2019) to remove `let preparedApp: PreparedSpecializedApp | undefined;`, call `preparedApp.finalize()` inside `Finalizer`, and bind `const preparedApp = prepareSpecializedApp({` directly.
- Note on `file_checks`: Adding an ESLint check (`yarn eslint {path}`) to `U03.checks` now would be refused by `plan-lint` because `plan-lint` runs each unit's `checks` against the file **currently on disk** before any new packet runs, and line 2010 on disk currently still has the `prefer-const` error.

### 2. Why `bugfix` red-check rules block re-running `U03` while the fix is applied, and what to do if needed
In a `bugfix` run, every `tests` unit (`U01`–`U03`) must carry `red_checks` that **must fail** (exit non-zero) when the test unit's packet is executed before the fix, and then pass after the fix. Because the codegen fixes (`U04`–`U07` in [`RouteResolutionApi.ts`](file:///Users/apple/Documents/GitHub/bs-cells/BS-BF-08/packages/frontend-plugin-api/src/apis/definitions/RouteResolutionApi.ts), [`RouteResolver.ts`](file:///Users/apple/Documents/GitHub/bs-cells/BS-BF-08/packages/frontend-app-api/src/routing/RouteResolver.ts), [`phaseApis.tsx`](file:///Users/apple/Documents/GitHub/bs-cells/BS-BF-08/packages/frontend-app-api/src/wiring/phaseApis.tsx), and [`useRouteRef.tsx`](file:///Users/apple/Documents/GitHub/bs-cells/BS-BF-08/packages/frontend-plugin-api/src/routing/useRouteRef.tsx)) are already applied in the working tree on disk, `U03`'s red check (`CI=true yarn test packages/frontend-app-api/src/wiring/createSpecializedApp.test.tsx -t prepareSpecializedApp`) now passes (`437/437` tests pass) and cannot fail on the current working tree.

If the executor rejects `U03`'s packet because its `red_checks` pass on the already-fixed tree, the person should:
1. Edit [`packages/frontend-app-api/src/wiring/createSpecializedApp.test.tsx`](file:///Users/apple/Documents/GitHub/bs-cells/BS-BF-08/packages/frontend-app-api/src/wiring/createSpecializedApp.test.tsx#L2010-L2019) lines 2010–2019 to replace `let preparedApp: PreparedSpecializedApp | undefined;` / `preparedApp = prepareSpecializedApp({` with `const preparedApp = prepareSpecializedApp({` (and `preparedApp.finalize()` on line 2014).
2. Run the verification and API report generation command:
   ```sh
   CI=true yarn test packages/frontend-app-api packages/frontend-plugin-api && yarn tsc && yarn lint:all && yarn build:api-reports
   ```
